title: Dominó Cubano: Doble Nueve
tagline: Cuban partnership dominoes. Read the table, trust your partner.
description: Real Cuban partnership dominoes with the full double-nine set, played the way it's played in Miami's Domino Park and across the Caribbean. Your AI partner actually reads the table: every pass proves what a seat doesn't hold. Three difficulty tiers put that to real use, up to full Torneo partnership reading. No chips, no stakes - first team to 100 wins.
howToPlay: You and the seat across from you are partners against the other two - ten tiles each, fifteen stay asleep.
Drag a tile from your rack onto either glowing end of the line - it plays if either number matches.
No match? Tap Pass - the game only lets you pass when you truly have nothing to play.
Every pass is a clue: it proves that seat holds nothing matching either open end, for the rest of the hand.
A hand ends when someone empties their rack, or all four seats pass in a row - lowest pips wins the block.
First team to 100 points wins the match. Choose Casual, Club or Torneo difficulty before you deal in.
